requirements.text: The Receipt add button must never overlap the Recent activity list on a phone screen.
The Mileage add button must never overlap the Recent activity list on a phone screen.
The "Receipt saved" confirmation message must never overlap the Recent activity list on a phone screen.
Each activity row in the Recent activity list must display its amount.
The Recent activity list must be scrollable so that it can scroll past the Receipt and Mileage add buttons and the "Receipt saved" confirmation.
All bottom tab labels (Dashboard, Receipts, Mileage, Settings) must be fully visible on a 390x844 phone screen.
Do not modify or remove any existing feature, test, or screen; all current functionality must remain working after the layout changes.
